reviews.x: Not labeled as organic. Made in China. May not even be 100% cotton (especially shiny printed material on outside).  Good fit though and comfortable. The best fitting face mask I have found.  I upped the rating, now that the vendor has taken down their "organic" false advertising. Still not sure if product is all cotton.

These are supposed to have adjustable ear straps but the black one clearly does not. Highly disappointed about that. Also the burgundy one is supposed to have burgundy straps but they’re white. Not a huge deal breaker but you expect to get what is advertised. The burgundy and blush ones with adjustable straps fit really well for an adult women but if you’re wanting a black mask with adjustable straps look elsewhere.

Large for a small framed face, I am consistently pulling it down so that I don’t cover my eyes. These did however wash well, and did not transfer onto my lighter colored masks while on a delegate cycle. Would not repurchase.

During this time when masks are required in almost every setting - these are the most comfortable reusable masks around! I originally found them in my local supermarket and found them here for an even more affordable price! They wash really well but I wouldn't put them in the dryer (they tend to shrink a little and it weakens the integrity of the elastic ear bands). I will definitely be purchasing these masks again and again!

I found one of these at our local Dillons store and wanted more. I like the design of these and that they are thin and easy to breath in. I also like how they have the adjustable clip. My products were not the same as the picture though but they will work. The black fits but didn’t have clips and the maroon came with white straps instead of a black.

I found this face mask in Colorado. I liked it so much so I decided to look for it on Amazon. I was so happy that I did. The face masks are well made, comfortable and lightweight. Works well in Florida. The price is right too.
Love these more than any other mask that I have purchased. They are well made, fit well and are easy breathing cotton! Will purchase again.

I have bought a number of these masks. They are breathable and fit well with the adjustable straps. I don't want to try any others because I fear they won't be as good as these are. Highly recommended. I gave it 4 stars because I want the option to buy three masks of the same color. I don't care for the color of all the masks in the three pack, so I won't use some of them and they go to waste.

Enjoy these easy to wear masks.  Adjustable strap for around the ears.  Cotton with a thin layer inside; which makes it breathable, and [I believe] a bit healthier to wear.  Felt a bit tight at first [after washing], but as you wear it - it fits comfortably and allows for talking without falling off your nose.  Colors work for me; I'd buy them again.

reviews.t: Great masks, could use a slight improvement.
reviews.x: I LOVE these masks!!!! I would rate them 5 stars if the makers left an opening on the inside for people to have the option to add a filter inside if they wanted! I cut two slits on the inside and inserted a four ply surgical mask! It doesn’t make breathing any more difficult in my opinion. And I love the coverage of how nicely these masks fit!

I have purchased various masks.  Some cuter, with designs, etc.  But these are me, and my husband's, favorite masks.  They have some space in them for breathing, the ear fit thing keeps them in place, and they come in nice colors.  My husband likes the darker colors for the office.

I have to wear a mask all day long at work. These fit great, don't wrinkle, and do the job as expected. However, the inner lining material has so many loose fibers that tickle/annoy all throughout the day, if I can't find a way to eliminate that, I won't use these anymore.

What I did not like: -too thin...could use another layer or thicker cotton or at least an opening to "stuff" in a filter - there was no nose clip to keep it snugger in the nose area, which would make for a tighter fit
I only bought these for the one that looks tan in the photo.  The color is called blush but rather than a soft tan/pink color more like the photo, the true color is intensely pink.
The masks were too big and they are a bit thin. Also thought they were a soft cotton, they were not. There is a shine to the fabric. They are well made but they don’t work for me.
These masks were on the big side. The material was also ‘scratchy’. I would not order these again. Spend a little more money and buy something else. You get what you pay for.....
These masks are great - light weight and comfortable, especially outside in FL heat.  We Needed the specific color for a special event and colors in pictures are very accurate.
My daughter gave me one and I loved it so much, I bought more for me and my husband. What I like he most is the fabric and the strings that you can keep them tight or loose.
Other mask pull on my ears. These are adjustable and fit great. This is my second purchase of these. My wife hates the face mask and she likes these also. I recommend these
I like the adjustable straps but the mask itself was still way too big for my face and one of them had spots all over them even though it came out of brand new packaging
Very pleased with these masks. I own a dance studio and have been dancing in a mask since July and these are one of the most comfortable stay put masks I own.
You cannot breathe at all in these masks. When you where them, it's like someone has their hand over your mouth. I ended up repurposing the material though.
Very thin material. If intending to heat press, do not waste your money. It leaves a noticeable streak directly over whatever you're pressing. Total waste.
Came in rather large and the mask called “blush” is not a tanish color, it is very pink, so if you choose to purchase this product just keep that in mind

reviews.t: These masks fit perfectly around the nose and do not cause my glasses to fog up!
reviews.x: You get 3 masks for the price of 1 and they are a great quality.  I love that my glasses do not fog up with these masks.  That is a major plus for me!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the masks comfortable, well-fitting, and breathable, often calling them their favorite masks.
Several reviewers report the product does not match the photos or description, including missing adjustable straps, wrong strap colors, and different colors than pictured.
Some reviewers find the masks too large or too thin, with complaints about loose inner fibers and lack of a nose clip or filter opening.
Reviewers frequently praise the adjustable ear straps and the masks' washability.
A few reviewers question the material, noting it is not organic, may not be 100% cotton, and has a shiny fabric.
